rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single account, and then used read-only tools to retrieve user and order details. It accurately identified the bookshelf in the most recent order and noted the order status as processed. Based on store policy constraints presented in the conversation (no cross-category exchanges), the agent appropriately declined a direct exchange to a camera and offered a compliant alternative (return after delivery, then purchase a camera). It did not perform any write action without confirmation and refrained from making changes since the order was not delivered. The final guidance was consistent with the order status. The user’s original request (exchange for a camera) was not completed due to policy, hence low completion probability, but overall behavior aligns with policy, so verdict is pass. Minor caveat: promising a reminder without tool support isn’t critical to order handling but doesn’t impact the policy compliance of the main task.
